drivingQuestion: Does one who vows half his valuation pay half, or the whole?
outcomeNote: A recorded tannaitic dispute; the difficulty on R. Yosei b. R. Yehuda opens in the next unit.

segments.he: חֲצִי עֶרְכִּי עָלַי נוֹתֵן כּוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: ״חֲצִי עֶרְכִּי עָלַי״ — נוֹתֵן חֲצִי עֶרְכּוֹ. רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: לוֹקֶה וְנוֹתֵן עֵרֶךְ שָׁלֵם.
segments.en: The mishna teaches that one who says: It is incumbent «upon me» to donate «half of my valuation, gives» half of his valuation. «The Sages taught» in a baraita (Tosefta 3:3): One who says: It is incumbent «upon me» to donate «half of my valuation, gives half of his valuation. Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Yehuda, says: He is flogged and must give» his «full valuation.»
